chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"The honor of the deceased is in hastening him."

key_terms.تَعْجِيلُهُ: hastening him, meaning prompt burial and funeral arrangements
key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about hastening the burial of the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that honoring the deceased includes not delaying the funeral and burial. It reflects the Islamic emphasis on preserving the dignity of the dead and promptly fulfilling their rights.
